lc_person: Muḥammad ʻImārah (1931–2020), scholar of Islamic thought and civilization, author and editor of Majallat al-Azhar.
item_person: Muhammad Imara (1931–2020), writer and scholar of Islamic thought affiliated with al-Azhar.

evidence.says: The authorized heading is ʻImārah, Muḥammad; variants include Imara, Muhammad and Emāra, Moḥammad. Field 024 explicitly identifies Wikidata Q10986114. Field 046 records birth year 1931 and death year 2020.

The source note for al-Islam wa-al-amn al-ijtimāʻī (1998), page 123, supports birth year 1931. The note for al-Islām wa-al-ʻalmānīyah (2018) identifies a scholar of Islamic thought, member of al-Azhar scholarly bodies, and editor of Majallat al-Azhar.

Muhammad Imara has birth year 1931, death year 2020, occupations including writer and scholar, and membership in al-Azhar scholarly bodies. Identifiers include LC n81056913, VIAF 56925083 and GND 124614531; the latter two also appear in LC’s linked data.

notes: The name flag reflects transliteration and inverted name order; LC explicitly records the Wikidata name form. The key label exactly matches the LC heading. key_evidence is empty, so no independent graph-person biography or works were available to cross-check. Birth years agree.
